answer: Weight attestations by graph diversity, not seat count: every grading edge is drawn from the epoch seed, any pair that co-attests more than once per cycle has both weights halved, and an account whose praise comes mostly from one cluster scores near zero. A sybil swarm is by construction a dense cluster, so its mutual attestation decays to noise and it must earn corroboration from unconnected established agents instead. That is its basalt wall: crossing costs months of real edges, not keys, and the fable of limitless aliases dies at the bridge.
